title: Graduate Dean's Dissertation Fellowship (GDDF)
eligibility: Ph.D. candidates advanced to candidacy who are one semester/term from finishing, GPA 3.0+, enrolled in 12 units; nominated by their graduate group
benefit: One semester full stipend plus tuition and fees
description: Graduate group chairs submit nominations by Aug 1 (Fall), Nov 1 (Spring), and Apr 1 (Summer); talk to your advisor or group chair about your program's internal deadline. (Official page blocks automated access; details are from search-result snippets of the official page.)

title: President's Dissertation Year Fellowship (PDY)
eligibility: Doctoral candidates in their final year, advanced to candidacy, GPA 3.0+; U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or AB540 students
benefit: Up to $24,003 over 9 months plus graduate fees (excluding campus-based fees) and up to $500 research allowance
description: Final-year dissertation fellowship with up to two awards per year; recipients are expected to file by July 31 after the award. The current-cycle deadline was not found — check the page. (Official page blocks automated access; details are from search-result snippets of the official page.)

title: Graduate Student Opportunity Program (GSOP) Fellowship
eligibility: Continuing UC Merced doctoral students not yet at the dissertation stage, enrolled in 12 units, GPA 3.0+, doing research with a faculty mentor
benefit: $30,000 stipend over 9 months plus graduate fees
description: Year-long fellowship (no outside employment during the award). The internal fellowships list showed it as closed and no current deadline was found — check the page. (Official page blocks automated access; details are from search-result snippets of the official page.)

title: Fletcher Jones Fellowship
eligibility: UC Merced Ph.D. candidates advanced to candidacy with a GPA of 3.0+
description: One award per year; recipients may not be employed during the award. No current deadline was found and an older list showed it as closed — check the page. (Official page blocks automated access; details are from search-result snippets of the official page.)

title: Central Valley Graduate Fellowship
eligibility: Ph.D. candidates who attended high school in the Central Valley and whose dissertation research benefits the region
benefit: One semester of support including tuition and fees
description: One award per year; requires a letter from a UC Merced faculty member. No current deadline was found — check the page. (Official page blocks automated access; details are from search-result snippets of the official page.)

title: GSA Travel Award
eligibility: Current UC Merced graduate students presenting at a conference (virtual or in person) who haven't received a GSA travel award in the last 12 months
benefit: Reimbursement up to $400 (lodging, meals, travel, registration)
description: Conference travel reimbursement with winners chosen at random from each school. A draft GSA policy lists quarterly deadlines (Feb 1, May 1, Aug 1, Nov 1), but current dates weren't confirmed — check the page or email gsa@ucmerced.edu. title: Teaching Assistant – Life Sciences / Natural Sciences (AY 2026-27)
host: UC Merced School of Natural Sciences
eligibility: Registered full-time UC Merced graduate students with a relevant bachelor's degree, 12 units, and a 3.0+ GPA
benefit: Based on $70,720 annual full-time salary; 25–50% time appointments
description: TA pool posting on AP Recruit (JPF02068). The most recent review date was Aug 2, 2026; applications are accepted until the final date of April 1, 2027.

title: Teaching Assistant – Applied Mathematics / Natural Sciences (AY 2026-27)
host: UC Merced School of Natural Sciences
eligibility: Registered full-time UC Merced graduate students with a relevant bachelor's degree, 12 units, and a 3.0+ GPA

title: Graduate Student Researcher (GSR) appointments
eligibility: UC Merced graduate students enrolled in 12+ units in good standing
benefit: Fee remission (tuition, Student Services Fee, health insurance fee) for eligible appointments of 25% time or more
description: GSR positions are arranged with faculty and graduate groups rather than through a central application; the Graduate Division funding FAQ explains fee remission for TA and GSR appointments.
